label: Ensure open
description: If the check element is already visible, skip. Otherwise click the opener (drawer, panel, + button) and wait until the check element is visible. Optional skipOpenIfSelectors avoid toggling a drawer that is already showing its cards. Optional fallbackDrag runs a dragDrop when the check target is still missing (for example add a 1 Column row so .empty-component exists). Use when a later click only works after a panel is open, and clicking the opener while it is already open would close it.

formSchema.label: Open selectors (click if check is hidden)
